parsed.note_claim: Cigarettes contain diacetyl and vaping does not cause popcorn lung.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Diacetyl is contained in cigarette smoke, but it is banned as an ingredient in UK-regulated nicotine vapes and e-liquids.
parsed.reason: The page confirms diacetyl is in cigarette smoke and vaping does not cause popcorn lung, but does not substantiate the specific 750x statistic or the claim that cigarettes never caused the disease.
